title: Adult Dry Cat Food - Chicken & Vegetable

details.description: This pet food by Me-o is made of whole grain cereal, chicken meat, vegetable protein, and fish meal. It contains taurine which is essential for the proper functioning of the eyes. It also contains omega 3 and 6 which helps to nourish coat and skin and the low sodium formula helps to decrease the risk of high blood pressure, prevents kidney and heart diseases. High in vitamin C, D, and phosphorus, this food will help boost the immunity system, strengthen the teeth and bone
details.ingredients: Wholegrain Cereals, poultry, meal, vegetable protien,iodized salt,vitamins and minerals, antioxidants,food coloruing
details.usageInstructions: To avoid indigestion associated with abrupt changes, slowly replace increasing quantities of old food with Me-O Cat food untill all the old food has been completely replaced in one week
